name: Community Service
overview: Scripture calls believers to humility and unity, urging them to adopt a mindset that values others above themselves and to avoid pride, as taught in Romans 12:16. Galatians 6:10 encourages Christians to seize every opportunity to do good, prioritizing kindness especially toward fellow believers. Hebrews 10:24 further exhorts the community to actively inspire one another toward love and good deeds, highlighting the importance of mutual encouragement in serving others.
